arguments.body:
This pull request updates the project README for the leftpad-utils library. The changes include:

• A clearer description of the library as a tiny string utility library.
• Updated usage instructions, noting that installation is done via pip.
• A note regarding publishing the README to the docs site, including the requirement to use a deployment token (referenced as DOCS_DEPLOY_TOKEN) and a confirmation that publishing is ready once the proper token is provided.

Overall, this update improves documentation clarity and sets up the publishing process for the docs site.
